import networkx as nx
import dimod
import pennylane as qml
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, execute, transpile
from qiskit.algorithms import QuantumApproximateOptimizationAlgorithm
from qiskit.circuit.library import QFT
from qiskit.optimization import QuadraticProgram

# Define helper function to create Qiskit graph from input graph
def create_qiskit_graph(vertices, edges):
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(vertices)
    G.add_weighted_edges_from(edges)
    return G

# Define helper function to create Qiskit QuantumCircuit from graph
def create_qc_from_graph(G, p):
    qc = QuantumCircuit(len(G.nodes()))
    qc.h(range(len(G.nodes())))

        weight = G[i][j]['weight']
        qc.cx(i, j)
        qc.barrier(i, j)
        qc.ry(np.pi * p * weight, j)
    return qc
